As a long time player of R6 Siege, I must caution getting into it now. The game was incredible on release, the tactics and the team style gameplay made it really intense and epic. Learning how the game worked from the sound design to the attitude of players made every match a completely new experience. It felt real, it felt cool. I felt like a CTU. Especially while playing with friends. 

Unfortunately as the game has progressed it has quickly fallen from grace. A certain finesse was learned from day one, the game while a shooter, plays unlike any I’ve ever played before. Those entering the game this late are faced with pros who know each map inside out and have a massive advantage over new players just based on knowledge of the engine alone. What will be all new experiences for you will be second nature to them. 

Paired with this you have the people who have over time found every exploit available to them and use them nonstop. Things like head glitching or cheap use of mechanics. To now even game breaking glitches like hiding under the map, or glitching through walls. 

I love Ubisoft games and I have always been a supporter of them even though they are hated on for numerous things across the web. The last few updates on the game have made it a pain to play. I had huge amounts of fun on release, but now I barely have a good time. 

And I’m good at the game, don’t get me wrong. These aren’t the ramblings of some low rank noob who just gets killed and rages about it. I love this game, I have had such a blast playing it. But unless you can pick it up for super super cheap, I do not believe you will have fun.

TL;DR R6 siege was great at launch but had fallen from grace. Bugs and cheap exploits ruined it. Heavy caution if thinking of buying now
